reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I really don't like swallowing pills, and this is two capsules every single day. The sachet and the lab report are nice, but it's still pills.
objection: Two capsules to swallow every day. I'd stop after a week, and then I've wasted $25 on a box I don't finish.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or a powder/drink version with the same tested magnesium bisglycinate.
